juntosSubtitle: Calm reminders for you or for the two of you.
coupleCounterUnset: Set your relationship date to see days together
couplePhotosPrompt: Choose a photo of you two
cardStateReady: A card arrived · Tap to open
discreetBanner: Discreet mode is on: names, photos and notes are hidden in widgets.
unpairedBanner: No partner connected: couple widgets show a neutral state.
offlineBanner: Showing the last saved data. Updates when back online.
howToAddStep1Body: Touch and hold an empty space until the icons jiggle.
howToAddStep2Body: In the top corner, search for QS-Flutter.
howToAddAndroidLockNote: On modern Android, widgets live on the home screen. The lock screen only shows neutral notification icons.
howToAddIosLockNote: On iOS 16 or newer, you can also add the lock-screen widget.
loadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.
ownMediumJarTitle: Tap to open a saved slip
ownMediumJarPrivacy: Private: only appears on your device
lockScreenPrivacyRule: Never shows names or messages on the lock screen.
lockScreenDisabledNote: The lock-screen widget is turned off in widget settings.
counterMidnightNote: The counter updates automatically at local midnight.
photosNeutralFallbackNote: When no local photo is cached (or in discreet mode), the widget shows only a neutral card with your time together.
partnerNoteSafeNote: Only notes your partner marked as widget-safe appear here.
partnerNoteDisabledNote: You turned off partner notes on widgets. Enable below if you want to show them.
cardEncounterPrivacyNote: This widget only shows card status and the next date — never names or card text.
statesPrecedenceNote: When both discreet mode and no-partner are active at the same time, widgets always degrade to the most neutral variant (Reminder).
